parameter.name: connectionType
parameter.description: Key store type: PGP_PRIVATE_KEY or PGP_PUBLIC_KEY.

parameter.name: name
parameter.description: Unique name the connection is identified by.

parameter.name: publicKeyPath
parameter.description: Public key-ring location, e.g. resources:keys/partner.asc (recommended); env:NAME; inline armored; or a file path. Legacy registry (gov:/..., conf:/...) also supported.

parameter.name: privateKeyPath
parameter.description: Secret key-ring location, e.g. resources:keys/alice-private.asc (recommended); env:NAME; inline armored; or a file path. Legacy registry (gov:/..., conf:/...) also supported.

parameter.name: keyIdentifier
parameter.description: Bound key identifier: a full fingerprint or a 16-hex 64-bit Key ID.

parameter.name: passphrase
parameter.description: Passphrase protecting the secret key; use a secure expression (e.g. $secret:...).
